The '''''Prentioch''''' was the personal [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]].

==History==
The ''Prentioch'' accompanied Utoxx Prentioch to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]], when he competed for the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|marine]] resources in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].
